project_type: TypeScript monorepo: React+Vite frontend, AWS Lambda backend, shared domain package, CDK infra. Monster-raising game (AIモンスター).
build_system: npm workspaces. Root `npm run build` builds shared (tsc) then backend+frontend. Node must be on PATH: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH".
test_framework: Node built-in test runner (node:test) with --experimental-strip-types. Shared tests: src/__tests__/*.ts (one file per area). Frontend tests: a SINGLE file src/game-ui.test.ts covering all pure UI helpers (NO DOM/React in tests).
test_command: npm test (shared, baseline 126) ; npm test -w @ddm/frontend (frontend, baseline 107)
verification_instructions: 1) export PATH for node. 2) npm run build must pass (tsc typechecks shared+frontend; EN i18n dict is typed Record<MessageKey,string> so a missing key is a compile error). 3) npm test -> shared pass count must grow from 126 with new absence tests, 0 fail. 4) npm test -w @ddm/frontend -> frontend pass count must grow from 107 with new recommended-action/threshold tests, 0 fail.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. Shared is compiled to dist/ by tsc during build but dist is gitignored/not committed.
setup_instructions: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"; dependencies already installed (node_modules present). If missing: npm install at root.
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET. No backend/Monster-type change needed. Cannot push or open PRs (orchestrator does that). Do NOT touch backup/previous-main branches.
contribution_requirements: JA is i18n source-of-truth (JA_MESSAGES const); EN is typed Record<MessageKey,string>; add BOTH ja+en for every new key. Keep JA byte-identical for EXISTING keys. No new runtime dependencies. Pure logic (no DOM/React) must be unit-testable under node:test. localStorage keys use `ddm.` prefix via guarded helpers (but this feature uses SESSION/component state for dismissal, not localStorage).
key_patterns: applyTimePassage(monster, now) returns a NEW monster after elapsed-time effects: hunger rises (clamped MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL=10), dirty set when ticks>=3, HP drains while starving (hungryLevel>=MAX), HP recovers +2/tick while sleeping, affection decays on neglect, multi-stage evolution with #38 form branching. TICK_MS=60000. Stages: baby->rookie(train>=2,age>=1min)->champion->ultimate. useMonster.ts mount effect: loads monster, computes `advance()` (=normalizeForm(normalizeBattleRecord(normalizeAffection(applyTimePassage)))) at `now`, sets state, persists if changed. A 15s TIME_TICK interval re-advances while open (must NOT be counted in welcome-back; summary is only the mount gap). Modal/panel a11y patterns: EvolutionBanner (role=status dismissible strip), OnboardingHint (role=status strip + close btn), ZukanModal/NameDialog/reset-confirm (role=dialog/alertdialog + aria-modal + focus-to-first + Tab trap + Escape close + focus restore). Pure helpers live in ui-helpers.ts and are tested in game-ui.test.ts.
relevant_files: packages/frontend/src/App.tsx (wires hook to UI; render WelcomeBack panel here)
packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts (pure helpers; add welcome-back formatting helper if needed)
directory_structure: packages/shared/src = pure domain logic + __tests__. packages/frontend/src = React app; components/ holds panels/dialogs; state/useMonster.ts owns game state; ui-helpers.ts pure helpers; i18n.ts dictionaries; game-ui.test.ts the single FE test file. packages/backend untouched. infra = CDK.
